movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers move in a circle; the audience forms a circle around them.
movement_profile.partnering: Dancers select a partner from the audience by offering a betel leaf.
movement_profile.posture: Dancers must have good posture, described as 'malebu-lebu/mabondeng'.

signature_moves.description: The dancer lies down near the audience member who is offering a gift.
signature_moves.name: Ballung

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the rhythmic accompaniment of drums and gongs, supporting vocal poetry that serves as advice.
music_profile.vocal_style: Singing (massita elong) performed by the dancers.

basic_steps: Tettong mabborong: Standing and gathering together
Mappakaraja: Performing a gesture of respect
Mappasompe: Giving a gift to a partner
Ballung: Reclining near an audience member
teaching.formation: A circle formation where the audience surrounds the dancers.
